description: When Austin Russell was 17 years old, he founded Luminar Technologies to work on a remote sensing technology called Lidar. Today, Austin is one of the world's youngest self-made billionaires, and Luminar may be on the verge of solving Austin's problem: How do you make Lidar cheap enough and good enough to use in millions of cars? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
classificationReason: Centers on making lidar affordable and capable for large-scale autonomous-vehicle deployment.
qualityReason: Focused discussion of a technical problem, company, and commercialization challenge.
